  | zero => simp [affineLoop]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp [affineLoop] at ih ⊢
      rw [ih]
      ring_nf
      simpa [pow_succ, mul_add, add_mul, mul_one] using ring_nf

theorem affineLoop_closed (n a : Nat) : affineLoop n a + 1 = 2 ^ n * (a + 1) := by
  apply affineLoop_n_forall a
